subject: P4 Science
global_instructions: For each question from 1 to 9, four options are given. One of them is the correct answer.
Make your choice (1, 2, 3 or 4) and shade your answer on the Optical Answer Sheet.

questions.main_question_text: The diagram below shows the human digestive system.

diagram_info.diagram_description: A diagram of the human digestive system with parts labeled A, B, C, and D.

parts.question_text: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Digestion is completed in part C.
No digestion takes place in part A.
No digestive juice is found in part B.
Digested food is absorbed into the blood in part D.
parts.correct_answer: Digested food is absorbed into the blood in part D.

questions.main_question_text: Study the table below on human body systems.

diagram_info.diagram_description: A table showing four body systems, an associated organ for each, and a function for that organ. Each row represents a choice for the multiple-choice question.

parts.question_text: Which of the following is correct?
options: Body system: Skeletal, Organ: Brain, Function of organ: To protect our main organs.
Body system: Muscular, Organ: Muscles, Function of organ: To give our body its shape.
Body system: Circulatory, Organ: Heart, Function of organ: To pump blood to the rest of the body.
Body system: Respiratory, Organ: Blood, Function of organ: To transport waste materials away from different parts of the body.
parts.correct_answer: Body system: Circulatory, Organ: Heart, Function of organ: To pump blood to the rest of the body.

questions.main_question_text: A, B, C, D and E are organs in the digestive system. The graph below shows the amount of undigested food leaving each organ after a meal.

diagram_info.diagram_description: A bar graph showing the amount of undigested food leaving five different organs (labeled B, C, D, E, and one unlabeled which is likely A based on the options table) in the digestive system.

parts.question_text: Which of the following is correct?
options: Mouth: A, Gullet: D, Small Intestine: B, Large Intestine: E
Mouth: B, Gullet: C, Small Intestine: D, Large Intestine: A
Mouth: E, Gullet: B, Small Intestine: C, Large Intestine: D
Mouth: B, Gullet: E, Small Intestine: A, Large Intestine: D
parts.correct_answer: Mouth: B, Gullet: C, Small Intestine: D, Large Intestine: A

questions.main_question_text: Alex and Kaylyn made the following statements about substance X which is in a container.

diagram_info.diagram_description: A diagram shows a beaker containing 'substance X'. Next to it are drawings of a boy, Alex, and a girl, Kaylyn. A speech bubble from Alex says, 'Substance X is a solid'. A speech bubble from Kaylyn says, 'Substance X is a liquid'.

parts.question_text: Which of the following tests can help determine which student is correct?
options: To find out if substance X has mass.
To find out if substance X can be compressed.
To find out if substance X has a definite shape.
To find out if substance X has a definite volume.
parts.correct_answer: To find out if substance X has a definite shape.

questions.main_question_text: An experiment was set up as shown below using a sealed metal container which holds 60 cm³ of water and 30 cm³ of air. 10 cm³ of water was removed from the container through the tap.

diagram_info.diagram_description: A diagram shows a sealed metal container with a pump and a tap. Inside the container, there is 60 cm³ of water at the bottom and 30 cm³ of air at the top.

parts.question_text: Which of the following correctly shows the amount of air in the container at the end of the experiment and the explanation of the results?
options: Amount of air in container: 30 cm³, Explanation of the results: Air can be compressed.
Amount of air in container: 30 cm³, Explanation of the results: Air has no definite volume.
Amount of air in container: 40 cm³, Explanation of the results: Air can be compressed.
Amount of air in container: 40 cm³, Explanation of the results: Air has no definite volume.
parts.correct_answer: Amount of air in container: 40 cm³, Explanation of the results: Air has no definite volume.

questions.main_question_text: The diagram below shows two objects, X and Y, placed on a beam balance.

diagram_info.diagram_description: A diagram shows a beam balance. Object X, a larger cylinder, is on the left pan, which is tilted downwards. Object Y, a smaller block, is on the right pan, which is higher up.

parts.question_text: Based on the observation above, which statement is correct?
options: Y has a greater mass than X.
Y has a greater volume than X.
Both X and Y are made of the same material.
Objects with smaller mass, have smaller volume.
parts.correct_answer: Both X and Y are made of the same material.

questions.main_question_text: Which one of the following is a source of light?

diagram_info.diagram_description: Four images representing the options for the question. Image (1) is a lit lamp. Image (2) is a mirror. Image (3) is an apple. Image (4) is a crescent moon.

parts.question_text: Which one of the following is a source of light?
options: a lit lamp
a mirror
an apple
the moon

questions.main_question_text: Kaelyn conducted an experiment and realised that she can see light through the holes of the cardboards when they are aligned. However, when one of the cardboards is shifted slightly, she no longer sees the light.

diagram_info.diagram_description: An experiment showing a torchlight shining through three cardboards with holes, observed by a person named Kaelyn. The diagram illustrates the concept of light traveling in a straight line.

parts.question_text: Which is the correct reason for her observation?
options: Light can be reflected.
Light cannot be blocked.
Light is a form of energy.
Light travels in a straight line.
parts.correct_answer: Light travels in a straight line.

diagram_info.diagram_description: A diagram illustrates how a person named Darwin sees a picture on an easel. A lamp hangs from the ceiling, providing light.

parts.question_text: How is Darwin able to see the picture?
options: The picture gives off light and enters his eyes.
The light reflects the picture and enters his eyes.
The light enters his eyes and reflects on the picture.
The light falls on the picture and gets reflected into his eyes.
parts.correct_answer: The light falls on the picture and gets reflected into his eyes.

global_instructions: For questions 10 to 14, write your answers in the spaces provided.
The number of marks available is shown in bracket [ ] at the end of each question or part question.
